title: 3.2.7 Lab: findRectangleArea (multi-parameter)
description: Define findRectangleArea(width, height) that works out the area and prints it, then call it twice. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Define findRectangleArea
steps.instructions: Define a function called findRectangleArea that takes two parameters, width and height.

steps.title: Print the area
steps.instructions: Inside the function, multiply width by height and print the answer with console.log, for example "Area: 12". This lab asks you to print inside the function; handing a value back with return is covered later, in 3.2.9.

steps.title: Call it twice
steps.instructions: Call findRectangleArea with two numbers, then call it again with two different numbers. Each call prints its own area.
